latin: An corpus compositum accipiat physicus a methaphysico, discordare fundamentaliter non possunt Auenrois et Auicenna, et si uerbis discrepent.
translation: On whether the physicist takes the composite body from the metaphysician, Averroes and Avicenna cannot be in fundamental disagreement, even if they diverge in their wording.
